correctness.rationale: Partition ball-witnesses into empty/singletons and selected pairs. The first collection of full simplices all contains ∅, giving a contractible simplicial cone B. Each pair witness e contributes exactly the relative triangle T_e=[{i},{j},e], not in B but attached along three boundary edges in B; distinct triangles meet only in B. The quotient K/B is a wedge of 2-spheres and the relative integral chain complex has one degree-two basis element per edge and no other relative faces; by cofibration and long exact sequence this proves integral homotopy and primitive generator claims. Oriented tetrahedral boundaries map with coefficient +1 to T_e; a transposition of its singleton endpoints reverses orientation, and edge insertion is an integral direct-summand inclusion. Independently all 75 graphs with n<=4 satisfied the cone/relative-triangle identity and K4 endpoint-swap oriented-edge trace 0. Finite checks corroborate only the inspected cases.
